purpose: Identify shared repository and control-plane write resources. Isolated RUNNER_TEMP artifacts are explicitly separated from repository resources; this audit remains partial for unrelated writers.

evidence_scope.limitation: The source discovery and assessment DAG writes outputs only beneath per-run RUNNER_TEMP and uploads immutable artifacts. Their only shared mutation is the task-bound GitHub Issue #315 append-only queue checkpoint CAS, fenced by logical/source-assessment-checkpoints and logical/production-pipeline. This narrows the DAG's shared write surface but does not complete transitive writer coverage, dynamic path tracing, or cross-workflow concurrency proof for the remaining production writers.

isolated_ephemeral_outputs.verification: producer identity + complete logical-document SHA-256 + immutable Actions artifact

modules/uu.conf.enforcement_evidence: task_scheduler protected-config digest guard and auto_sync publish-job pre/post staging checks
modules/uu.conf.scheduling_rule: Any detected modification must fail closed; no capability may claim write ownership.

resource_groups.note: auto_activate_sources writes the active domain source registry and activation log, affecting future production inputs. Publish restore can write the same allowlisted files. Current auto_sync is protected by the central production-pipeline fence; the script has no explicit per-resource lease.

Two active auto_sync steps write the same logical JSON document. Both write_document calls omit lease_required=True, so current serialization relies on the shared Watchdog production-pipeline mutex. This is workflow-level coordination, not per-mutation filesystem interception. Restore can replace the same logical document from allowlisted artifacts. Cross-workflow compatible per-document lease proof remains missing.

The durable queue is control-plane state stored as append-only, compressed GitHub Issue #315 comments. Each snapshot is SHA-256 chained to the prior revision; concurrent duplicate revisions resolve deterministically by earliest canonical comment ID. The repository automation/task_queue.json file is read-only bootstrap state. Local task_queue_runtime is runner-local only.

Per-URL results are stored only in the currently claimed task's assessment_checkpoint. Each mutation uses the append-only Issue #315 snapshot CAS and validates task identity, active task lease, exact predecessor run/digest and both logical resource fencing tokens. No repository assessment document is written or published.

lifecycle_gate.py writes milestone/monthly review state directly. The current auto_sync call is protected by the central production-pipeline fence; no separate per-resource lease assertion exists in the script. Allowlisted publish-mode restore is an additional writer and is serialized by the same auto_sync logical production-pipeline fence.

The owner baseline registrar writes only approval/pin metadata after verifying the exact owner-authored modules/uu.conf change. In auto_sync, these writes are guarded by the live Watchdog task/resource lease and the publisher reasserts the same fencing epoch before push. validate-config writes only its ephemeral workspace with contents:read. Historical artifact restore is explicitly excluded from these resources. This covers the registered production path; broader cross-workflow ownership audit remains partial.
Audit-only report and JSON output; publish restoration is another writer under the same auto_sync logical fence.
All three entrypoints can affect published policy lists; serialize them until a single-writer ownership boundary is enforced.

Report inventory now includes source activation, lineage, policy-source overlap, external-domain, config-drift, RULE-SET reference, RULE-SET/config overlap, project-status, lifecycle and conflict-sync outputs. restore_automation_state is an additional publish-mode writer for allowlisted reports. Exact path-to-writer coverage and per-report lock assertions remain partial.

The request-intake workflow validates up to 500 hostnames and appends a run-ID-idempotent JSON batch to GitHub Issue #317 comments. production_intent.py includes these batches in the production fingerprint, and import_request_observations.py merges them into the runner-local unclassified candidate buffer. No automation writes sources/request_domain_observations.json; that repository file is a read-only seed.

The deterministic review writes its checkpoint under the production task's shared logical/production-pipeline lease. On failed or cancelled audit, persist_review_cursor.py validates the uploaded checkpoint and updates or removes only sources/review_cursor.json after exact Watchdog task and live resource-lease validation. Cursor-only Git publication revalidates the task/resource proof before staging and pushing. No repository-local filesystem guard is installed.

The provenance builder writes the logical document through json_document_store; publish restoration may restore the same path and shards. Current auto_sync execution shares the production-pipeline fence, but no independent per-document lease is requested by the builder.
Manifest reconciliation and production/lifecycle/conflict flows share this resource.
Exact per-file writer coverage and indirect writes still require call-graph tracing.
The repair script modifies only one of two hard-coded paths, then the workflow stages exactly the selected path and publishes a run-specific PR branch. No direct main write is performed.

paths: path-selected JSON documents and their adjacent .manifest.json / shard files
resource_groups.note: The storage helper uses atomic replacement, JSONL shards, manifest switching, and old-shard cleanup. Locking by program ID is insufficient; lock the canonical document path and include manifest/shards in the same lease. The low-level helper is itself registered as a dynamic writer; callers must declare the canonical document and lease across all helper-managed child mutations.

resource_groups.lock_key: per-run RUNNER_TEMP isolation; shared checkpoint uses logical/production-pipeline + logical/source-assessment-checkpoints
resource_groups.note: All assessment documents are written under AUTOMATION_ARTIFACT_ROOT in RUNNER_TEMP and uploaded as an immutable Actions artifact. The main-branch sources/source_assessments.json is a read-only baseline. The only shared mutation is the current task's bounded assessment_checkpoint in GitHub Issue #315, protected by append-only snapshot CAS, task lease and both logical resource fences.

Candidate matrix reads runtime or persistent assessments plus source lineage, then writes a logical JSON document through json_document_store and a Markdown report. Allowlisted publish-mode restore is an additional writer and is serialized by the same auto_sync logical production-pipeline fence.

resource_groups.lock_key: per-run RUNNER_TEMP isolation + logical/source-discovery-run task lease
resource_groups.note: The current main discovery document is copied read-only into the isolated RUNNER_TEMP workspace as a merge baseline. discover_sources.py writes only beneath AUTOMATION_ARTIFACT_ROOT; the workflow verifies producer identity and full logical-document digest, then uploads an immutable artifact. No repository file is modified or published.

Watchdog now re-reads the current Blob SHA and re-merges the same run-scoped paths on each of up to three conditional Contents API PUT attempts. observed_run_ids makes retries idempotent when another run updates the path between attempts. Conflicts after the third attempt fail closed. Distinct runs remain concurrent; parallel-run integration/no-lost-update proof is outstanding.

required_before_enablement: CI and complete deterministic test suite pass for the capability.
The scheduler atomically acquires the shared production mutex and all declared output leases.
The child re-reads live queue state and checks the exact active fencing token at every filesystem mutation boundary.
The independent verifier accepts only matching runtime/persistent/report artifacts.
A controlled post-merge scheduler canary passes without changing modules/uu.conf.

For the independent source DAG, confirm the verified discovery artifact root is used by enqueue, claim, execute and post-execution read-only digest checks; all assessment outputs stay under RUNNER_TEMP and no repository path is staged.
